341-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Umori, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

401-3944-7452-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-7452-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

240-1879-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-1879-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3263-5231-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5231-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5231-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

465-585-3742-4251-7297.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2498-4691-7688.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
2498-4691-7688.description:
Activate M.O.D.O.K. by paying 3 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw three cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers three times, causing you to gain 6 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all M.O.D.O.K. abilities.

1734-2292-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-2466-5051-5078.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

5670-6792-6823--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6792-6823--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

2060-2577-6431-6797.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3951-4875-5703-6753.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4875-5703-6753.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1939-2034-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1939-2034-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom indestructible.
1939-2034-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2829-4871-6291.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1812-2059-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer
1812-2059-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the token Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

914-5530-5913.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5530-5913.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Dockside Extortionist and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-5530-5913.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1682-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1682-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1682-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

603-3967-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-3967-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2292-2857.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2292-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2292-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Viscera Seer.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1061-1576-5900.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{U}{U}{U} the first turn, with {4}{G}{U}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-5900.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-5900.description:
Give Timestream Navigator haste, if needed.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
When Forerunner of the Coalition enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1430-2947-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Mirror Image's power.
Repeat.

352-4539-4893.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
352-4539-4893.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating two Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Shifting Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

803-1909-4289-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
"Elf" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1909-4289-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {G}.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Emmara.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

717-779-833-2546.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability and Bone Miser's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Surly Badgersaur trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

936-2302-2353-5099.notablePrerequisites:
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
936-2302-2353-5099.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Mindcrank triggers, causing that player to mill a card.
Compost triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat steps 2-4.
